map.扬程怎么估？: How Do I Estimate the Head?
map.总扬程 = 沿程损失 + 局部损失 + 几何高差，再乘 1.05~1.10 裕量: Total head = friction loss + local loss + geometric elevation, then multiply by a 1.05 to 1.10 margin so the selection is not right at the limit.
map.流量和扬程谁先定？: Which Comes First, Flow or Head?
map.先由工艺定流量，再由管路阻力定扬程，二者共同决定功率与泵型。: The process sets the flow first, then the piping resistance sets the head; together they determine the power and the pump type.
